considerations: Baseline managed automation and shared vendor egress.
Pivot by service principal ID and check credential additions and Graph activity.
description: Review successful service principal sign-ins across multiple apps from one IP.

evidence.claim: Microsoft observed ARTEX-associated use of exposed cloud credentials, service-principal sign-ins from a reported IP, rapid cloud discovery and attempted access to Azure Key Vault and other resources.
evidence.location: Credential abuse via Entra ID and indicators sections

expected_output: One row per source IP and fifteen-minute window with four or more principals.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Review successful service principal sign-ins across multiple apps from one IP.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: One Address Signing In as Many Service Principals

1.json:
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType == "0" and isnotempty(IPAddress) and isnotempty(ServicePrincipalId)
| summarize SignIns = count(), Principals = dcount(ServicePrincipalId), Names = make_set(ServicePrincipalName, 12), Resources = make_set(ResourceDisplayName, 12) by IPAddress, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where Principals >= 4
| order by Principals desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
